summary: Steel fire tower about 84 ft (25.6 m) tall, dated 1933 by one lookout-history site; listed standing in Monroe County, WI; history and access unconfirmed.

events.note: Page dates the erection to 1933 and lists the Wisconsin Department of Conservation; it does not name a builder. Single source.

evidence.supports: Greenfield tower in Monroe County, listed as standing
approximately 84-foot steel tower erected in 1933 (84 ft is about 25.6 m)
evidence.quote: 1933: An approximately 84-foot tall steel tower erected.

evidence.supports: filed under the Wisconsin Department of Conservation; location line 18N-2W-9 in Monroe County
evidence.quote: Wisconsin - Monroe County - 18N-2W-9 - Wisconsin Department of Conservation

sources.title: Wisconsin Lookouts - Forest Fire Lookout Association

corrections.why: 18N-2W-9 appears to be a township, range and section location (T18N R2W S9) in the federal land survey, not an agency. The page names the Wisconsin Department of Conservation.

notes_for_editor: Build year (1933) and height (approximately 84 ft) rest on one compiled entry on the Forest Lookouts site, which cites no underlying record. Two web searches found no second source for the build date, builder, staffing or condition. The brief's agency value '18N' is a land-survey location and is corrected above. Next places to try: the Wisconsin Historical Society AHI, DNR fire tower records, and the Monroe County Historical Society. Access is unknown; the story says nothing about visiting beyond checking with the land manager.
